cases.name: disabled decision trigger
cases.sql: ALTER TABLE heimdall.audit_decisions DISABLE TRIGGER decision_resolution

cases.name: replica-only decision trigger
cases.sql: ALTER TABLE heimdall.audit_decisions ENABLE REPLICA TRIGGER decision_resolution

cases.name: disabled foreign key triggers
cases.sql: ALTER TABLE heimdall.audit_decisions DISABLE TRIGGER ALL

cases.name: changed guard body
cases.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION heimdall.guard_decision_resolution() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path=pg_catalog AS $$ BEGIN RETURN NEW; END; $$

cases.name: security definer guard
cases.sql: ALTER FUNCTION heimdall.guard_decision_resolution() SECURITY DEFINER

cases.name: guard search path
cases.sql: ALTER FUNCTION heimdall.guard_decision_resolution() SET search_path=public

cases.name: invalid index
cases.sql: UPDATE pg_catalog.pg_index SET indisvalid=false WHERE indexrelid='heimdall.audit_decisions_unresolved'::regclass

cases.name: index not write ready
cases.sql: UPDATE pg_catalog.pg_index SET indisready=false WHERE indexrelid='heimdall.audit_decisions_unresolved'::regclass

cases.name: index being dropped
cases.sql: UPDATE pg_catalog.pg_index SET indislive=false WHERE indexrelid='heimdall.audit_decisions_unresolved'::regclass

cases.name: missing unresolved index
cases.sql: DROP INDEX heimdall.audit_decisions_unresolved

cases.name: wrong unresolved index
cases.sql: DROP INDEX heimdall.audit_decisions_unresolved; CREATE INDEX audit_decisions_unresolved ON heimdall.audit_decisions(product_id,environment,decision_id)

cases.name: missing terminal uniqueness
cases.sql: ALTER TABLE heimdall.audit_decisions DROP CONSTRAINT audit_decisions_product_id_environment_terminal_event_id_key

cases.name: missing foreign key
cases.sql: ALTER TABLE heimdall.audit_decisions DROP CONSTRAINT audit_decisions_product_id_environment_request_event_id_fkey

cases.sql: ALTER TABLE heimdall.audit_decision_backfill DROP CONSTRAINT audit_decision_backfill_phase_check

cases.sql: ALTER TABLE heimdall.audit_decision_backfill ALTER COLUMN phase SET DEFAULT 'outcomes'

cases.sql: ALTER TABLE heimdall.audit_decision_backfill ALTER COLUMN scanned_count DROP NOT NULL

cases.name: unlogged checkpoints

cases.name: extra table
cases.sql: CREATE TABLE heimdall.unrecognized(id text)

cases.sql: ALTER SEQUENCE heimdall.record_revision_seq CYCLE
